registration.geometry: Z-up. Static cuboid rotated about +Y by 10 degrees. Its top plane passes through origin and descends +X. Sphere released from rest at exact tangency, with no separate rigid-body mass or imposed rotation.
registration.solver: Use the frozen PHY-01 solver/integration profile, including CCD. Nominal 5 ms macros with four 1250 us native steps. No UI, wall-clock input, randomization, settling pose reset or timestep adaptation.
registration.observation: Retain all native post-step states and public manifold observations. Require supporting solver contacts and positive cached normal impulse in the predeclared 0.4–1.0 s window, compatible plane normal, bounded signed geometric clearance and normal velocity. Public cached impulses are a support witness at observation time, not a per-substep force history.
registration.noSlip: For every native endpoint in the analysis window bound the tangent length of v_COM + omega cross (-r*n); n is the fixed plane normal. This geometric contact patch check does not use the solver's averaged contact point. 1 mm/s is a predata operational threshold for this isolated witness.
registration.oracle: Require the support and no-slip gates first. Compare each adjacent pair of observed time samples' downhill and +Y angular acceleration to g*sin(theta)/(1+I/(m*r^2)) and a/r, using analytic homogeneous-sphere I=2*m*r^2/5. Each error is bounded by 5% of its analytic reference.
registration.repeatability: Run two independently created identical nominal worlds from the same frozen source. Compare complete observed state/contact streams exactly in the same host process. This witness does not qualify convergence, cross-runtime replay, or either production physics engine.
